title: Unit – 2 : Session – 12 : SLO – 1 | User-Defined Packages
sections: // file mathutils/Adder.java:  package mathutils;  public class Adder { public int add(int a, int b){ return a + b; } }
// file mathutils/Multiplier.java:  package mathutils;  public class Multiplier { public int multiply(int a, int b){ return a * b; } }
// file Main.java:  import mathutils.Adder;  import mathutils.Multiplier;
public class Main { public static void main(String[] args){ Adder a = new Adder(); Multiplier m = new Multiplier(); System.out.println(a.add(4, 3)); System.out.println(m.multiply(4, 3)); } }
